recommendation: Keep the commit. If the work group wants to forbid Immunization.reason when status is not-done, handle that as a new current-version decision because later Event-pattern evidence supports more than one interpretation.
issue_request: FHIR-3758 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core Immunization issue requesting two invariants for the then-current refusedIndicator model: administered immunizations could not carry explanation.refusalReason, and not-administered immunizations could not carry reaction or explanation.reason.
initial_application: Commit 64fbbf28ef27948a7944954073c8df878bac2bc9 explicitly named #3758 and added the old wasNotGiven spreadsheet invariants while applying the related FHIR-3762/FHIR-5351 not-given rename. Jira comments later stated that the base Immunization schematron had those invariants.
additional_context: Current Immunization source is active and now uses status = not-done plus statusReason instead of the DSTU1 wasNotGiven/reasonNotGiven model. FHIR-54325 already supplies the current statusReason invariant equivalent to the old administered/refusalReason rule. FHIR-14377, FHIR-14374, and the workflow Zulip discussion show that current Immunization.reason/statusReason semantics should not mechanically inherit the old no-explanation.reason rule.
reconciliation: Added imm-3 to source/immunization/structuredefinition-Immunization.xml with expression status = 'not-done' implies reaction.empty(), plus matching valid and invalid invariant test bundles under source/immunization/invariant-tests/.
source_changes: source/immunization/structuredefinition-Immunization.xml: added imm-3 requiring reaction to be absent when Immunization.status is not-done.
source/immunization/invariant-tests/imm-3.f1.fail.json: added an invalid not-done Immunization with reaction.
source/immunization/invariant-tests/imm-3.p1.pass.json: added valid not-done-without-reaction and completed-with-reaction cases.
